name: ViniClip
tagline: Records video in the browser and cuts pauses, retakes and mistakes as you speak, ready to post.

awards: 1st Place - General Challenge // 1re place – Défi général

problem: Recording a clean video means retakes and hours of editing out pauses and mistakes.
solution: Streams browser audio to a backend that transcribes it (Moonshine), lets an LLM with function calling decide what to cut, and trims and stitches the segments with ffmpeg; it can also publish to a short-video platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: fumble a sentence, restart, and get a clean cut at the end of the recording.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “1st Place - General Challenge // 1re place – Défi général” among 260 submissions.
Edits during recording rather than after.
A problem every presenter knows, shown live in a 24-hour build.

lessons: Remove a step people hate and show it happening live.
